interface.name: noctalia_material_manager_v1
interface.description: A scene describes only its owning wl_surface. It never grants access to other clients, textures, screenshots, global theme settings, or lock content. The compositor may omit optical rendering during session lock and snapshots.

request.name: import_effect
request.description: Imports at most 32768 bytes from fd. The receiver reads exactly source_size, rejects trailing bytes, and recomputes the 32-byte transport SHA-256 over the canonical ABI and source bytes. The import radius must be the ABI-fixed 256 logical-pixel host cap; each scene plane selects its own 0..256 radius and parameters without re-keying source. accepted confirms transport validation only. ready is sent later after compositor compilation; clients must retain their native body until ready and a staged scene is applied.

interface.name: noctalia_material_effect_v1

description.summary: lifetime of one imported custom material effect

interface.description: accepted does not authorize removal of native pixels. ready means the current compositor backend compiled the exact digest and ABI. rejected is terminal for this object. Destroying the object releases the handle; committed scenes retain their own bounded reference until replacement or surface destruction.

interface.name: noctalia_material_surface_v1
interface.description: At most one object may exist per wl_surface. set_scene replaces pending scene state; the last valid pending scene becomes current with wl_surface commit. An empty plane list clears effects. Destruction clears effects. Payload is the bounded little-endian v5, v6 or v7 codec in scene_descriptor.h: at most 65536 bytes and 64 planes. All coordinates are logical surface coordinates. Per-plane affine transform, clipping, radii, continuous corner power (2 to 10), concave corner flags, material parameters, palette tint, opacity and semantic IDs are explicit. Foreground pixels are composited after the optical planes. Parent planes group ordinary controls. Explicit independent controls may publish nested optical planes; each carries its optional rounded paint mask. Rejected payloads leave current and pending state intact. Optical lens radius and mapping affect sampling only; painted radii, mask coverage and input geometry remain independently owned.

request.name: set_scene
request.description: Payload must not exceed 4080 bytes, including for version 1 clients.

event.name: armed

description.summary: active custom scene validated before surface commit

event.description: The latest complete pending active custom scene has been decoded, all effect references are strongly retained and ready, and the receiver will apply this exact serial on the next wl_surface commit unless it is replaced or rejected first. Armed does not make the scene current and does not identify a client buffer by itself.

event.name: lease_revoked

description.summary: restore native ownership with a matching commit

event.description: The compositor keeps drawing a bounded standard fallback for the current leased descriptor. The client must submit a token-zero v7 descriptor and native-body buffer in the same wl_surface commit. Resources remain retained until that commit is applied and lease_released is sent.

event.name: lease_released

description.summary: native replacement applied and lease resources released

event.description: scene_serial names the token-zero descriptor committed with the native body. Older-token release and revoke events do not affect a newer binding lease.

request.name: set_scene_chunk
request.description: Each nonempty chunk has at most 3072 bytes. Total size is 1 to 65536. Offset zero starts or replaces the single upload for this object. Subsequent chunks must have the same serial and total size and exactly the next byte offset. Invalid chunks discard the upload and emit rejected, preserving valid pending/current state. Only a complete, valid descriptor replaces pending state. A surface commit discards any incomplete upload. set_scene also discards an incomplete upload. Surface destruction releases upload state. Version 3 or newer peers may use v6 custom-effect references. Version 5 peers may use v7 only with the lease handshake. Version 1 or 2 peers use v5 and retain native rendering.

request.name: request_lease

description.summary: request continuous ownership for an applied staged scene

request.description: staged_scene_serial must name the current applied token-zero v7 scene. The receiver derives its ordered target and ready-resource signature. A grant retains those resources but does not authorize native omission until lease_armed identifies the first active descriptor.
